blocks.html: Living in a place where everything essential is within easy reach has become almost a necessity because of how the pandemic forcibly altered the way we live our lives.

Nowadays, when looking for a place to live in, one must considerably factor its proximity to lifestyle areas, medical facilities, commercial centers, food establishments, and public transportation, which are all important in living a convenient and comfortable new normal lifestyle.
Apart from an excellent location, one must also pick a place that promotes the health and wellness of residents as lifestyles evolve through time.
Moreover, one must choose a place that supports everyday family needs, which is what Sonora Garden Residences aims to offer and more in the heart of Las Piñas City.

A joint venture of DMCI Homes and Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), the three-building development located near Alabang-Zapote Road and within the vicinity of Robinsons Place Las Piñas complex, Sonora Garden Residences certainly fits the requirements for a first home of a young family.
Nestled in a long-established family residential community, Barangay Talon Uno, Sonora Garden Residences aims to create a nurturing family environment
with its generous unit layouts that are complemented by expansive open spaces and family-oriented amenities.
When one is looking for a first home, it is smart to look into this modern contemporary-themed condominium set in a close-knit community where strong familial bonds are cherished and valued.

Recognizing the community’s unique culture and charm, Sonora Garden Residences aims to offer dwelling spaces that are ideal for young couples in the area who are planning to start their own family right within their comfort zone.

The 1.45-hectare pre-selling condominium’s three buildings—Cadence, Liran, and Stellan—feature larger than usual DMCI Homes unit cuts spanning 28 to 114.5 square meters (sqm) with balcony to suit the evolving needs of a young family.

Other than being spacious, the living spaces also have adequate supply of fresh air and natural light to offer healthy living spaces for the whole family by virtue of DMCI Homes’ Lumiventt® Technology healthy building design.
Furthermore, the amenities and design of the Sonora Garden Residences were carefully planned to meet the families’ growing needs and changing lifestyle.
The condominium boasts open spaces, lush gardens, and a variety of resort-inspired amenities.
Residents can relax at the lap pool and leisure pool; enjoy a workout at the fitness gym; or play hoops at the basketball court.
An awesome treat also awaits at the Sky Lounge of the Cadence building, where one can have a splendid view of the city while enjoying a meal at the snack bar.
There is also a jogging path, pool deck, open lounge, entertainment room and many other amenities ideal for family and community activities.
Likewise, Sonora Garden Residences has amenities that kids will surely enjoy such as children’s play area, kiddie pool, and open lawn.
Meanwhile, facilities like high-speed elevators, card-operated laundry system, convenience store, and water station make living in the property convenient and trouble-free for the whole family.
In addition, Sonora Garden Residences will have its own team of property management professionals who will ensure the upkeep, safety, and security of the property.
With all these features and more, Sonora Garden Residences is indeed the best choice to consider for one’s first home with a reasonable price starting from Php4.06 million onwards.

Sonora Garden Residences is a joint venture of DMCI Homes and Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC). To learn more about the project, call DMCI Homes at (632) 5324-8888/0917 880 8800 or reach RLC Residences through email at asksales@rlcresidences.com and mobile no. 0925 800 0000.
